purpose: Test whether the grouped MLP6--7 E/A/U/W composition law is stable at prompt level by leave-one-row-out coefficient transfer on the frozen fronted-OOD causal lattice.
data_status: RETROSPECTIVE_FROZEN_RECEIPT_REANALYSIS; leave-one-row-out predictions are frozen before inspecting row-level endpoint liveness or subset errors; no new text or model outcome is opened

binding_evidence.finding: Valid 16-row OOD causal lattice retains base and exact margin outcomes for every E/A/U/W background, direction, and source.
Population coefficients plus two target endpoints predict cross-cell intermediate subset means, but prompt-level stability is untested.

novelty_audit: Authority searches for leave-one-row-out MLP6, MLP6 row profiles, prompt-level background gates, row-level composition prediction, and population-profile endpoints found no prior test; the sole match was the board's newly stated next step.
This changes the identification unit from construction means to prompts and forbids target-row intermediate conditions from coefficient estimation.
map: For each direction and held-out row, compute the exact E/A/U/W Shapley gate profile from the other seven rows only. Use that profile and only the held-out row's q(empty), q(EAUW) endpoints to predict its fourteen intermediate q(S) values. Rows with |q(EAUW)-q(empty)| >= 0.02 are endpoint-live for normalized scoring; all rows remain in absolute-error and sign accounting.

predictions.pred_a_receipt_and_row_lattices_close: The bound receipt is valid and every one of 16 rows has one base and exact opposite-source margin outcome for every background subset; endpoint predictions close to 1e-12.
predictions.pred_b_endpoint_liveness_is_common: At least 12 of 16 rows have absolute endpoint shift at least 0.02.
predictions.pred_c_loo_prompt_prediction: Across endpoint-live rows, median normalized MAE is at most 0.20 and the 75th percentile is at most 0.30; maximum absolute MAE across all rows is at most 0.05 margin units.
predictions.pred_d_loo_beats_uniform: Leave-one-row-out factor-specific coefficients reduce aggregate squared error by at least 10% versus uniform four-factor endpoint interpolation on endpoint-live rows.
predictions.pred_e_direction_sign_is_row_stable: At least 75% of endpoint-live rows have endpoint-shift sign matching their direction's aggregate sign.
predictions.pred_f_no_cardinality_drift: For each direction and subset cardinality one, two, and three, mean signed residual divided by endpoint scale over live rows has absolute value at most 0.15.

null: If c or d fails, the aggregate composition rule does not identify prompt-level computation. If b fails, normalized prompt scoring is underpowered and absolute errors control the conclusion. If e fails, direction-level gating averages heterogeneous prompt mechanisms. Preserve failures and do not drop live rows or refit target intermediates.
